Dragon Ball Rooftop Bar for the Fire Show
Mar 2026 • Couples
We spent an evening at Dragon Ball Rooftop Bar and it was a great spot to watch the Dragon Bridge fire show. The view was perfect and saved us from dealing with the big crowds on the street.

It does get very busy before and after the show, but that just adds to the atmosphere. The staff were friendly and handled everything well even when it was packed.

Overall, we had a really good evening and would happily go back.

Over priced , over hyped and as a stand alone bar without the bridge it would be shut. Rubbish.
Mar 2026 • Couples
Went to see the dragon ‘show’ from this rooftop bar ( nowhere near a show but that’s reviewed separately ) …..

so let’s start with the positive - staff were amazing , worked off their feet and very happy and friendly. 

Beer is overpriced , stools to sit on uncomfortable , the food, waited 35 mins for garlic bread ( our gut feeling told us this was not the place to order food but we needed something ) was overpriced and it arrived pathetically covered in literally zero garlic. 

This bar would not remain open if it was not for the dragon bridge and as so many tourists arrive weekly a new breed of suckers get drawn in to the “best view , great show ‘ routine. 

Beer was buy 10 get one free - yes, you read that correctly ! 

Literally 2 hours and several Dong we will never get back. Rubbish.

Great Views!
Aug 2024 • Couples
We came to the dragon ball bar to watch the dragon show. We arrived at around 7:30 and got a seat at the front. Unfortunately they only accept cash, however, they were very nice and one of the staff actually drove me to the atm to get money out. The drinks are reasonably priced, the staff are friendly and attentive and it has a great view of the show. It’s tough to get a grab afterwards, but you can just stroll across the roads to the markets or get a massage on the second level of the building. It is somewhat off the beaten path but very safe and friendly. Definitely recommend
